text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized into clear paragraphs with first/second/last signals","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how coherently the essay is structured and how clearly its ideas are sequenced for the reader."},{"evidence":"“First, it is known… Secondly… Lastly…”","quality":"transitional control","description":"This captures the effective use of linking words and sentence openers to guide the reader through the response."},{"evidence":"“Aladdin park,” “Sea view,” “Safari Park”","quality":"specific detail","description":"This captures the use of concrete examples and elaboration rather than only general claims."},{"evidence":"“chair lifts,” “horse and camel rides,” “Chicken Korma with buttery naan”","quality":"descriptive elaboration","description":"This captures richer sensory and descriptive language that makes the ideas more vivid and developed."},{"evidence":"“The rides are exhilarating,” “they are very welcoming and kind”","quality":"sentence fluency","description":"This captures more natural-sounding sentence construction and smoother phrasing overall."},{"evidence":"“As you can see” repeated to wrap up points","quality":"paragraph closure","description":"This captures the ability to end points clearly and connect examples back to the main idea."}]}
